name: PostAction.refreshBc collapses the tree
description: A custom action with PostAction.refreshBc updates the record and reloads the whole tree: the expanded node is collapsed.
descriptionHtml:
A custom action with PostAction.refreshBc updates the record and reloads the whole tree: the expanded node is collapsed.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Tree.TreeNodeRefreshTest#refreshBcCollapsesTree into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
statusMessage: PostAction.refreshBc for the Tree widget is planned for the next release: the tree must be collapsed after it (specification, section 8)
